about: Seed questions, second file (D208 step one done from the watch list, review-2026-10-31-method.md R1): the first file's v1-v9 with their provenance written, v10 made general (financing commitments and capacity backstops to customers), and v11-v23 drafted from poc/universe.json's NVDA and theme watch entries plus the driver classes the list lacks (EPS root, China share, Rubin Ultra, obligations). Each question names its source; none was written from an article inside the measured window. Ladders marked draft are the analyst's to confirm before the judge's output is read; placement reads only the question and the key. 2026-11-01: the rack-price seed (old v7, 'What will a Rubin-generation NVL72 rack cost ... first volume shipments') removed as look-ahead: its wording matched a 2026-07-06 article inside the window (Alex: no forward-looking seeds); the later ids moved up by one (old v8-v23 are v7-v22).
